descriptions.value: An out-of-bounds write issue was addressed with improved bounds checking. This issue is fixed in macOS Golden Gate 27.2, macOS Sequoia 15.8.2, macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. An attacker on the local network may be able to corrupt process memory.

descriptions.description: An attacker on the local network may be able to corrupt process memory

descriptions.value: An out-of-bounds read issue was addressed with improved input validation. This issue is fixed in macOS Golden Gate 27.2. A remote attacker may cause an unexpected process termination.

descriptions.description: A remote attacker may cause an unexpected process termination

descriptions.value: Improper access control in Microsoft Office SharePoint allows an authorized attacker to disclose information over a network.

assertions.title: Microsoft Office SharePoint Information Disclosure Vulnerability
